title: Murder In The French Concession Of A Korean Named Ti Tai Zui

page_data.en:
Form No
G. 85.00.35
H.F..
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. P. Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date February 17. 19 36.
Subject Murder in the French Concession of a Korean named Ri Tai Zui.
Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by
With reference to the endorsement of Mr. T. Robertson,
Assistant Commissioner, on the attached file, the undersigned
interviewed Mr. T. Saheki, Superintendent of the local Japanese
Consular Police, at the Consulate on February 15, and was
informed that there is no development in the murder case of a
Korean named Ri Tai Zui(李泰瑞), which occurred in the
French Concession on November 7, 1935. The Japanese Consular
Police are still endeavouring to locate a Korean named Kim Sho-
on(金昌根), alleged slayer of Ri Tai Zui.
D. Kamashita
D. S.
Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No...）

鉴于助理总监 T. Robertson 先生在所附卷宗上的批注，具名者于2月15日在日本领事馆会见了当地日本领事警察总监 T. Saheki 先生，获悉关于1935年11月7日发生在法租界的朝鲜人李泰瑞（李泰瑞）谋杀案，目前尚无进展。日本领事警察仍在努力寻找被指称为李泰瑞凶手的朝鲜人金昌根（Kim Sho-on）。
D. Kamashita

page_data.en:
NIPPO

KOREAN MURDERED IN FRENCH CONCESSION BY UNKNOWN
COUNTRYMAN; ASSASSIN ARRESTED

In connection with the assassination of Li
Tung Beng on the morning of November 7 in the French
Concession, the Japanese Consular Police have arrested
a Korean named Li on suspicion. The deceased is believed
to have been dealing in contraband goods but the motive
of the crime cannot definitely be attributed to personal
enmity.
Enquiries are being made concerning his
political relations.
page_data.zh:
《日日新闻》

朝鲜人在法租界被身份不明的同胞杀害；刺客被捕

关于11月7日上午在法租界发生的李东邦（Li Tung Beng）遇刺案，日本领事警察已因涉嫌逮捕了一名姓李的朝鲜人。据信死者从事走私货物交易，但犯罪动机不能明确归因于个人恩怨。
正在对其政治关系进行调查。

C.R.J
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Special Branch. Sa............ Stations
REPORT
Date. December 31, 1935

Subject. Murder in the French Concession of a Korean named RI TAI ZUI.

Made by D.S. Jones................................ Forwarded by J B Ross D.

With reference to the endorsement of the Deputy Commiss-
ioner, Special Branch on the report by D.S. Komashite dated
November 21, 1935, I visited French Police Headquarters today
with the object of obtaining if possible some further particulars
regarding this case.

No additional information was forthcoming and I was
informed by Inspector Berthier that the French Police had made
no progress with their investigations into the murder of RI TAI
ZUI. From the conversation I had with Inspector Berthier I
gathered that this case is no longer engaging the attention of
the French investigating officers. When I asked if I might see
the latest reports on the subject I was told that none had been
submitted during the past few weeks. It would seem that the
French Police are leaving it to the Japanese authorities to
solve the mystery of the Korean's sudden death.
Police
I understand that the Japanese Consular are still enquiring
into the case.

D.C. Special Branch
G. Jones
D.S.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.B. REGISTRY
File No. 7065
No. S. B. D. 7065
Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date November 21, 1935.

Subject Further Information regarding the Murder of Ri Tai Zui,
a Korean, in the French Concession on November 7, 1935.
Made by D. S. Komashita Forwarded by J.B.Roz, A.I.

In continuation of my report dated November 11 regarding
the murder of a Korean named Ri Tai Zui(李泰瑞) in the
French Concession on November 7, 1935, it has been ascertained
that a Korean named Ri San Sei(李三弌), a witness, who had
been detained at the Japanese Consulate for inquiries, has
been released. From this witness, it was learnt that the
culprit was a Korean named Kim Sho Kon(金昌根), aged 38,
native of Keijo, Korea. This individual was a member of the
Korean Provisional Government which was established in Shanghai
in March, 1919. He joined the Hei In Volunteer Corps, a terro-
rist party, organized by the radical members of the Provisional
Government in January 1926. He is also suspected of having
thrown a bomb at the Japanese Consulate on April 14 and
September 25, 1926.
The Consular Police request that this information be
dealt with confidentially.

Ag. cp
Information

（印：OFFICE OF POLICE SHANGHAI 2 DEC. 1935）

日期：1935年11月21日。

事由：关于1935年11月7日在法租界发生的朝鲜人李泰瑞（Ri Tai Zui）谋杀案的进一步信息。
呈报人：D. S. Komashita 转呈人：J.B.Roz, A.I.

继我于11月11日关于1935年11月7日在法租界发生的朝鲜人李泰瑞（李泰瑞）谋杀案的报告之后，现已查明，曾作为证人被拘留在日本领事馆接受问询的朝鲜人李三弌（Ri San Sei）已被释放。从该证人处获悉，凶手是一名名为金昌根（Kim Sho Kon）的朝鲜人，现年38岁，籍贯为朝鲜京城（Keijo）。此人是1919年3月在上海成立的韩国临时政府成员。他于1926年1月加入了由临时政府激进分子组织的恐怖政党“黑仁义勇队”（Hei In Volunteer Corps）。他还涉嫌于1926年4月14日和9月25日向日本领事馆投掷炸弹。
领事警察要求对此信息保密处理。

Ag. cp

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. S. B. REGISTR
S. B. D. 7065
S. 2. Special Branch J.D.S.
REPORT
Date November 11, 1935.
Subject Ri Tai Zui, a Korean, was murdered by an unknown Korean
on November 7, 1935.
Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by J.B.Ross A.C.
With reference to the attached, I have to state that
a Korean named Ri Tai Zui(李泰瑞), aged 34, victim in the
murder case, had resided in Shanghai for some 8 years up to
the time of his death. He was a bachelor and unemployed, but
it is believed that he was making his living by dealing in
narcotics. Since October 23, 1935, he resided in the ground
floor room of a house rented by another Korean named Ri San Sei
(李三成) at Si Ka Dang Villege near Route Vallon. Ri San Sei,
aged 27, was speaking with a Russian on some business at the
ground floor front room at about 12 noon on November 7, 1935,
when an unknown Korean entered the room stating that he wished
to rent a room in the house and took a seat beside them. When
Ri San Sei went to the lavatory shortly after, the unknown
Korean proceeded to Ri Tai Zui's room and shot him through the
head. Ri Tai Zui is supposed to have been asleep at the time
of this attack. The unknown Korean immediately made good his
escape through a back door before Ri San Sei returned to the
front room. Ri San Sei is detained at the local Japanese
Consulate for enquiries. According to the Consular Police,
nothing is so far obtainable regarding the identity of the
culprit and the motive for this crime.
D. Kamashita
J.D.S.
（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE SHANGHAI 12 NOV. 1935）
Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER CRIME BRANCH 11 NOV 1935）
（批：SI, Please note in connection with inquiry into Danish hood case. JMS 12/11 R.J.O. Lomax 12/11/35 O.C. (Crime) Information. JMS 11 NOV. 1935）

报告
日期：1935年11月11日。
事由：1935年11月7日，朝鲜人李泰瑞（Ri Tai Zui）被一名身份不明的朝鲜人谋杀。
呈报人：D. S. Kamashita 转呈人：J.B.Ross A.C.
关于所附文件，兹陈述如下：本案受害者、现年34岁的朝鲜人李泰瑞（李泰瑞），在去世前已在上海居住约8年。他是单身且无业，但据信其靠贩卖毒品为生。自1935年10月23日起，他居住在瓦隆路（Route Vallon）附近施家当村（Si Ka Dang Villege）另一名为李三成（Ri San Sei）的朝鲜人所租房屋的一楼房间。1935年11月7日中午12时许，27岁的李三成正在一楼前屋与一名俄国人洽谈生意，此时一名身份不明的朝鲜人进入房间，称欲租用屋内房间，并在他们身旁坐下。不久后李三成去洗手间时，该不明身份的朝鲜人进入李泰瑞的房间，向其头部开枪。据推测，李泰瑞在遇袭时正在熟睡。在该不明身份的朝鲜人趁李三成返回前屋之前，立即通过后门逃脱。李三成被拘留在当地日本领事馆接受问询。据领事警察称，目前尚无法获得关于凶手身份及犯罪动机的任何信息。
D. Kamashita
J.D.S.
（印：上海警务总监办公室 1935年11月12日）
特别处副总监。
（印：刑事科副总监 1935年11月11日）
（批：SI，请注意与此前丹麦帮伙案件的调查关联。 JMS 12/11 R.J.O. Lomax 1935年11月12日 O.C. (刑事科) 情报。 JMS 1935年11月11日）

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 8, 1935

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 7065
Date 8 / 11 / 35

KOREAN MURDERED
BY COMPATRIOT

Motive for Assassination
Sought by Police

A Korean named Li Tai, about
thirty years of age, was shot and
killed by another Korean at Si Ka
Dang Village, near Route Vallon, yes-
terday morning. The assassin, whose
name was not learned by the police,
entered Li's house on the pretext of
wishing to rent a room. Conducted
into the kitchen, the stranger sud-
denly drew an automatic pistol of
heavy calibre, fired, and ran out of
the house. His victim, shot in the
head, slumped to the floor, dead.
Detectives who investigated the
crime said that nothing had been
taken from the house by the mur-
derer. The motive for the crime had
not been determined late yesterday.

S2, Please obtain details.
J.W.S.

D.S. James.
D.S. Kamoshta.
DSR 8/11.

《字林西报》，1935年11月8日，星期五

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别处登记室
S. B. D. 7065
日期 1935年11月8日

朝鲜人
被同胞杀害

警方寻求
刺杀动机

一名名为李泰（Li Tai）、约三十岁的朝鲜人，昨天上午在瓦隆路附近的施家当村被另一名朝鲜人枪杀。刺客姓名警方尚未获知，他以想租房为借口进入李家。被带入厨房后，这名陌生人突然掏出一把大口径自动手枪，开枪后跑出屋外。受害者头部中弹，瘫倒在地，当场死亡。
调查此案的侦探表示，凶手未从屋内拿走任何物品。截至昨天深夜，犯罪动机尚未确定。

S2，请获取详情。
J.W.S.

D.S. James.
D.S. Kamoshta.
DSR 11月8日。
